extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 4.0 m tileable steel guard rail: A-profile (double-wave W-beam) rail 310 x 83 x 3 mm, top edge 0.75 m, sigma posts 100 x 50 x 4 mm every 2.0 m (x = -1.0 / +1.0 m), 150 mm spacer blocks, M16 button-head bolts
extras.notes: Tileable along X: seam edges at x = -2.0 and +2.0 m where the rail sits in its base position, so tiles join without offset (4 m element, post spacing 2 m continues). Rail splice with 320 mm overlap on the post at x = +1.0 m, upstream rail on the traffic side (traffic along +X on the -Y side), 8 splice bolts. Traffic side = -Y, posts end at ground level (z = 0). Hot-dip galvanized, light road grime.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
